solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Provided sustenance or a cover for the head

parts.note: to provide sustenance is to feed; past tense
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A choice between being fed and being given a hat.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' does double duty in the surface but belongs to the wordplay; the definition is 'cover for the head', with 'a' read as part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fedora is a soft felt hat with a creased crown, a classic piece of headwear.

clue.text: Speck of snow beginning to fall above Windermere?

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece placed above another simply comes first
the beginning of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: first letter of fall
Windermere is the largest lake in England's Lake District; the question mark marks a definition by example

explanation.surface: Snow starting to fall over the Lake District.
explanation.definitionFit: A single snowflake is a flake, a tiny speck of falling snow.

clue.text: Lack of harmony in club never ceased in the end

parts.note: a disco is a nightclub for dancing; 'in' reads as part of the surface phrase 'in club'

indicators.note: the end of each word is its final letter, so each of the two words gives only its last

parts.note: last letters of never and ceased

explanation.surface: Trouble at a club that never let up.
explanation.definitionFit: Discord is disagreement or, in music, a clash of notes: the absence of harmony.

clue.text: Renewed inactivity mostly calling for immediate attention

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: rest is a state of inactivity
something urgent demands to be dealt with at once

explanation.surface: A spell of idleness that now needs urgent action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Renewed' reads like a description of the inactivity, but it stands alone as the definition at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Resurgent means rising again after a decline, so renewed in strength or activity.

clue.text: Consequences of exploit led by one politician

definitions.note: plural noun for a singular mass noun; impact covers all the effects

indicators.note: being led by something means that thing goes in front, fixing the order

parts.note: Roman numeral one
Member of Parliament
an exploit is a deed or act

explanation.surface: The fallout from a stunt headed by a lone politician.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay reads backwards from the clue order: 'one politician' leads, then the exploit.
explanation.definitionFit: Impact is the effect or influence something has, its consequences.

clue.text: Mad fella in charge

parts.note: a fella is a man
IC is the abbreviation for in charge

explanation.surface: A crazy man is running the show.
explanation.definitionFit: Manic describes frenzied, wildly excited behaviour, close to mad.

clue.text: Messenger and mailmen periodically carrying letters

indicators.note: carrying means holding something inside, so one piece goes within another
something done periodically happens at regular intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: second, fourth and sixth letters of mailmen
letters collectively are the post

explanation.surface: Postmen out on their rounds with the letters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Messenger and mailmen' tempts a solver to look for postal words throughout, but 'mailmen' only supplies a few of its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle is literally one sent out, a messenger, from the Greek apostolos.

clue.text: Exhaustion that is primarily accompanied by inflammation

indicators.note: being accompanied by something means it comes along next, so one piece follows the other
primarily points to what comes first, here the opening letters of the two words before it

parts.note: first letters of that and is
inflamed skin shows redness

explanation.surface: Fatigue that comes along with a bout of inflammation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that is' looks like it should give IE, but here only its initials are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiredness is the state of being worn out, a milder word for exhaustion.

clue.text: Musician requiring help on middle part of album

indicators.note: in an across answer, one piece set on another comes after it
the middle part of a five-letter word is its third letter

parts.note: the central letter of album
to help is to assist

explanation.surface: A musician who needs help with the middle section of a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A bassist plays the bass guitar or double bass, so is a musician.

clue.text: Supporting a plan, as company directors often are?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: agreeing with and backing a scheme
second meaning: directors sit on the company's board

explanation.walkthrough: The second meaning is a playful literal reading, flagged by the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on board is an idiom for being in agreement, and literally it describes membership of a board of directors.

clue.text: Instant money from abroad injected into extremely stupid calamity

indicators.note: something injected goes inside, so these pieces are placed within the other
the extremes of a word are its two ends, so only the outer letters are kept

parts.note: first and last letters of stupid
a tick is an instant, as in 'just a tick'
the yen is the currency of Japan

explanation.surface: Foreign cash rushed into a foolish disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Instant' looks like an adjective for the money, as in instant cash, but it is a noun for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming to a sticky end is an idiom for an unpleasant fate, a calamity.

clue.text: Popular, fresh comedic art

indicators.note: something made fresh is new, so the letters are formed into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A fresh brand of comic art that wins public favour.
explanation.definitionFit: Democratic means of or for the people, which is the root sense of popular.

clue.text: Commotion excessively overwhelming daughter

indicators.note: to overwhelm is to engulf, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: too means excessively
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A huge fuss swamping someone's daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or disturbance, an informal word for commotion.

clue.text: Fashionable, regularly admired low- budget film?

parts.note: in means in fashion

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every second letter is taken

parts.note: second, fourth and sixth letters of admired

explanation.surface: A cheap but stylish film that critics admire now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: An indie is a film from an independent studio, typically made on a small budget; the question mark marks it as an example.

clue.text: New pub on fire? This might help with flare-up

indicators.note: new signals something remade, so the letters are formed into a different order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A new pub has caught fire, and something is needed to deal with the blaze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flare-up' sounds like flames but is an inflammation, which the painkiller treats.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibuprofen is an anti-inflammatory drug, taken to calm swelling and pain when a condition flares up.

clue.text: Was an MC matched on record?

indicators.note: a recording carries spoken sound, so the word is taken by how it is heard

parts.note: to match things is to compare them

explanation.surface: Asking whether a host's patter was a match for the recording.
explanation.definitionFit: To compere is to act as master of ceremonies, introducing the acts at a show.

clue.text: Lumber on around eastern metropolis

indicators.note: around suggests turning things about, so the letters are moved into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
E is the abbreviation for eastern

explanation.surface: Plodding heavily around a city in the east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like a container signal, but it shuffles all the letters, the E included.
explanation.definitionFit: Melbourne is Australia's second city, a large metropolis in the state of Victoria.

clue.text: Bit of wit? It breaks up dull experts talking

parts.note: a pun is a small piece of wordplay wit

indicators.note: breaking something up splits it open, so a piece is placed inside it

parts.note: dry can mean dull and uninteresting
taken as written

explanation.surface: A moment of humour livens up tedious talking heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'experts talking' is the definition: the activity of pundits, not the pundits themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Punditry is the commentary offered by pundits, so it is experts holding forth.

clue.text: French intellectual drawn in by splendid erotica

indicators.note: being drawn in by the following words means sitting inside them, across the gap

parts.note: runs from the end of splendid into the start of erotica

explanation.surface: A French thinker drawn to fine erotic writing.
explanation.walkthrough: Fitting, since Diderot himself wrote a racy novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Denis Diderot was the French Enlightenment philosopher who edited the Encyclopédie.

clue.text: Lights surrounding the far edge of the city

indicators.note: surrounding means enclosing, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: LEDs are light-emitting diodes, small lights

indicators.note: the far edge of a word is its very end, so only its final letter is kept

parts.note: last letter of the

explanation.surface: Lights ringing the outskirts of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: LEDs are light-emitting diodes. Leeds is a large city in Yorkshire, northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeds is a major city in West Yorkshire.

clue.text: Take out vanilla flavouring

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a verb, to remove or pull out
second meaning: a noun, as in the concentrate used in baking

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to remove; as a noun it is the concentrated essence, and vanilla flavouring is commonly sold under that name.

clue.text: Good, clear feature of crosswords?

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
to clear something away is to rid a place of it

explanation.surface: A clean, tidy layout is a mark of a decent crossword.
explanation.definitionFit: Every crossword is printed on a grid of squares, so the grid is one of its features.

clue.text: Business group against rampant tourism

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons

indicators.note: rampant means running wild, so the letters are allowed to run out of their order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A trade body campaigning against tourism running out of control.
explanation.definitionFit: A consortium is an association of companies joined for a common business purpose.

clue.text: Orchestra position in church broadcast

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: A seat in the orchestra for a concert broadcast from a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A chair is a player's rank within an orchestral section, such as first chair violin.

clue.text: App customer absorbs first section of how-to guide

indicators.note: absorbing something means taking it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: someone who uses an app is its user

indicators.note: the first section of a word is taken as its opening letter alone

parts.note: first letter of how-to

explanation.surface: Someone using an app reads the start of the instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'how-to guide' reads as one phrase, but 'guide' is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: An usher guides people to their seats, so to usher is to guide.

clue.text: Where adventurous drivers may go, travelling far with food

indicators.note: travelling means moving about, so the letters move into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Intrepid motorists heading a long way with their provisions.
explanation.definitionFit: Off-road driving leaves paved roads for rough tracks, the terrain adventurous drivers seek.

clue.text: Republican entertained by excellent moralising

indicators.note: a guest entertained by a host is taken in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: peachy is informal for excellent
R is the abbreviation for Republican

explanation.surface: A Republican hosted by a fine, sermonising group.
explanation.definitionFit: Preachy describes someone who lectures others on morals in a tiresome way.

clue.text: Old city in the centre of Benin had character

indicators.note: the centre of a five-letter word is its third letter alone

parts.note: the middle letter of Benin

indicators.note: placed in means set inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: to have a meal is to eat, so had can mean ate
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: An ancient city at the heart of the West African state once had its own character.
explanation.walkthrough: Ur is the crosswords' favourite old city, the Sumerian site in modern Iraq.
explanation.definitionFit: Nature means the essential character or disposition of a person or thing.

clue.text: Teach guys to run

parts.note: guys are men
taken as written
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An instruction to coach some men in running.
explanation.definitionFit: To mentor someone is to advise and train them, a form of teaching.
